Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was backing out of a parking space at a grocery store in Conroe, Texas, when my vehicle was struck on the rear
quarter panel by another car that was moving through the lane behind me. I had checked my mirrors and saw nothing
approaching, so the impact came as a surprise. I stopped right away, got out, and exchanged information with the
other driver before the police arrived to take a short report. Since then I have described the collision the same way
each time I have spoken with the adjuster, the repair shop, and my medical provider. I am the named driver on this
policy and I have been the primary operator of the insured vehicle for the full coverage period. The impact left me with
stiffness and pain in my neck and lower back, which I have been treating with my doctor and a physical therapist.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
